_readme: FIAT OUTSTANDING ART (19 Oct, Matt): the Map's other three zones and nine sites; the order's three heads - a face, the fight's three poses, their place for the order card, their unique. After the test reads.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_outstanding_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; ++ --only <name> ++ --force to reroll). Regenerate with python3 tools/make_outstanding_manifest.py.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art portrait, head and shoulders, of the Lineman, a big man in his fifties who kept the lights on for the order's people only: a cracked rubber lineman's coat, a high-cut helmet with a lamp on its front, climbing spurs slung round his neck, a coil of cable over one shoulder, a face burnt red down one side. Looking just past the viewer. Post-collapse Britain, overcast light. One person centred, filling the frame, no text, no border, plain dark background.
